description: Header file defining interfaces and wrappers for Kineto profiler integration in PyTorch, including conditional compilation based on Kineto availability and mobile platform considerations.

classes.name: DeviceAndResource
classes.description: Structure representing device and resource identifiers for profiling.

classes.name: TraceWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper around libkineto::CpuTraceBuffer for managing CPU trace activities.

classes.name: ActivityTraceWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper around libkineto::ActivityTraceInterface for managing activity trace data.

methods.name: addMetadata
methods.description: Adds metadata to a trace activity.

methods.name: kineto_ids
methods.description: Returns device and resource identifiers for Kineto profiling.

methods.name: prepareTrace
methods.description: Prepares a profiling trace with specified activities and configuration.

methods.name: toggleCollectionDynamic
methods.description: Enables or disables dynamic collection of profiling data.

methods.name: stopTrace
methods.description: Stops the current profiling trace and returns an activity trace wrapper.

methods.name: pushCorrelationId
methods.description: Pushes a correlation ID for profiling.

methods.name: popUserCorrelationId
methods.description: Pops the last user correlation ID.

methods.name: deviceTypeFromActivity
methods.description: Converts activity type to device type.
